# Overview

Below is a summary of the release process of the [ggml-org](https://github.com/ggml-org) projects. The document should be useful for downstream project to decide how to build and distribute them.

# Projects

## [ggml-org/ggml](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml)

- Core library used by the rest of the projects
- Release builds use semantic versioning: `vX.Y.Z`
  - Git tags: `vX.Y.Z`
- Release list: [v0](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases?q=tag:v0)

  ### Downstreams

  - Homebrew: `ggml` [package](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/ggml), [formula](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/main/Formula/g/ggml.rb)
  - Debian:
    - `ggml` [package](https://packages.debian.org/source/sid/ggml), [packaging repository](https://salsa.debian.org/deeplearning-team/ggml)
    - `ggml-cuda` [package](https://packages.debian.org/source/sid/ggml-cuda) (separate build because of non-free CUDA dependencies)

## [ggml-org/llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp)

- Includes an internal copy of `ggml` that may deviate from the official released version
- The internal copy is used for [nightly development builds](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases) from the `master` branch
- The nightly builds use commit number `[NUM]` for version:
  - Git tags: `b[NUM]`
  - Build with CMake option `-DLLAMA_BUILD_IS_DEV=ON`
- Official release builds use semantic versioning: `vX.Y.Z`
  - Git tags: `vX.Y.Z`
  - Build with CMake option `-DLLAMA_BUILD_IS_DEV=OFF`
  - The release tags are created on the condition that the internal `ggml` copy is identical to the released `ggml` copy. This guarantees that a downstream building from the release tags and linking to a system-wide `ggml` will be compatible.
- Release list: [v0](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases?q=tag:v0)

  ### Downstreams

  - ggml-org: `llama.app` [webpage](https://llama.app), [packaging repository](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama-install.sh)
    - Does not link to a system-level `ggml` (i.e. packs the internal `ggml` copy)
    - Publishes the nightly builds instead of the official releases (TODO: switch to official releases?)
  - Homebrew: `llama.cpp` [package](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/llama.cpp), [formula](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/main/Formula/l/llama.cpp.rb)
    - Depends on the `ggml` package and links to the installed system-wide `ggml`
  - Debian: `llama.cpp` [package](https://packages.debian.org/source/sid/llama.cpp), [packaging repository](https://salsa.debian.org/deeplearning-team/llama.cpp)
    - Depends on the `ggml` and `ggml-cuda` packages and links to the installed system-wide `ggml`
  - Winget: `llama.cpp` [workflow](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/.github/workflows/winget.yml), [manifests](https://github.com/microsoft/winget-pkgs/tree/master/manifests/g/ggml/llamacpp)
    - Does not link to a system-level `ggml` (i.e. packs the internal `ggml` copy)
    - Publishes the nightly builds instead of the official releases (TODO: switch to official releases?)

## [ggml-org/whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp)

- Includes an internal copy of `ggml` that may deviate from the official released version
- There are no nightly builds - only official releases
- Official release builds use semantic versioning:
  - Git tags: `vX.Y.Z`
  - Build with CMake option `-DWHISPER_BUILD_IS_DEV=OFF`
- The release tags are created on the condition that the internal `ggml` copy is identical to the released `ggml` copy. This guarantees that a downstream building from the release tags and linking to a system-wide `ggml` will be compatible.
- Release list: [v1](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/releases?q=tag:v1)

  ### Downstreams
  
  - Homebrew: `whisper-cpp` [package](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/whisper-cpp), [formula](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/main/Formula/w/whisper-cpp.rb)
    - TODO: rename to `whisper.cpp`?
  - Debian: `whisper.cpp` [package](https://packages.debian.org/source/sid/whisper.cpp), [packaging repository](https://salsa.debian.org/deeplearning-team/whisper.cpp)

## [ggml-org/llama.cpp/gguf-py](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/tree/master/gguf-py)

- Release builds use semantic versioning: `vX.Y.Z`
  - Git tags: `gguf-vX.Y.Z`

  ### Downstreams
  
  - pip: `gguf` [package](https://pypi.org/project/gguf/), [workflow](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/.github/workflows/gguf-publish.yml)

## [ggml-org/llama.vim](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.vim)

- Uses semantic versioning: `vX.Y.Z`
